@@ -0,0 +1,94 @@
+apiVersion: gateway.kgateway.dev/v1alpha1
+kind: TrafficPolicy
+metadata:
+  name: valid-empty
+spec:
+  consistentHash: {}
+---
+apiVersion: gateway.kgateway.dev/v1alpha1
+kind: TrafficPolicy
+metadata:
+  name: valid-full
+spec:
+  consistentHash:
+    headers:
+    - headerName: x-user
+      regexRewrite:
+        pattern: "^user-(.*)$"
+        substitution: "\\1"
+      terminal: true
+    cookies:
+    - name: session
+      ttl: 1h30m
+      path: /
+      attributes:
+      - name: SameSite
+        value: Strict
+      - name: Secure
+    - name: other
+      ttl: "3600"
+    queryParameters:
+    - name: user
+    filterState:
+    - key: io.istio.peer_principal
+    sourceIp:
+      terminal: false
+---
+apiVersion: gateway.kgateway.dev/v1alpha1
+kind: TrafficPolicy
+metadata:
+  name: valid-disable
+spec:
+  consistentHash:
+    disable: true
+---
+apiVersion: gateway.kgateway.dev/v1alpha1
+kind: TrafficPolicy
+metadata:
+  name: valid-disable-false-with-fields
+spec:
+  consistentHash:
+    disable: false
+    sourceIp: {}
+---
+_err: no other fields may be set when disable is true
+apiVersion: gateway.kgateway.dev/v1alpha1
+kind: TrafficPolicy
+metadata:
+  name: invalid-disable-with-headers
+spec:
+  consistentHash:
+    disable: true
+    headers:
+    - headerName: x-user
+---
+_err: no other fields may be set when disable is true
+apiVersion: gateway.kgateway.dev/v1alpha1
+kind: TrafficPolicy
+metadata:
+  name: invalid-disable-with-source-ip
+spec:
+  consistentHash:
+    disable: true
+    sourceIp: {}
+---
+_err: ttl must be a duration (e.g. 1h30m) or an integer number of seconds
+apiVersion: gateway.kgateway.dev/v1alpha1
+kind: TrafficPolicy
+metadata:
+  name: invalid-cookie-ttl
+spec:
+  consistentHash:
+    cookies:
+    - name: session
+      ttl: one-hour
+---
+_err: spec.consistentHash.headers[0].headerName
+apiVersion: gateway.kgateway.dev/v1alpha1
+kind: TrafficPolicy
+metadata:
+  name: invalid-empty-header-name
+spec:
+  consistentHash:
+    headers:
+    - headerName: ""
diff --git a/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/consistent_hash_types.go b/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/consistent_hash_types.go
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..b02d7f233
--- /dev/null
+++ b/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/consistent_hash_types.go
@@ -0,0 +1,161 @@
+package kgateway
+
+// ConsistentHash configures how the hash key used by hashing load balancers is computed.
+// Hash policies are evaluated in the following order: headers, cookies, queryParameters,
+// filterState, sourceIp.
+// +kubebuilder:validation:XValidation:rule="!has(self.disable) || !self.disable || (!has(self.headers) && !has(self.cookies) && !has(self.queryParameters) && !has(self.filterState) && !has(self.sourceIp))",message="no other fields may be set when disable is true"
+type ConsistentHash struct {
+	// Disable suppresses consistent hashing on the route, including any hash policies
+	// inherited from policies attached at a broader scope.
+	// +optional
+	Disable *bool `json:"disable,omitempty"`
+
+	// Headers specifies request headers whose values are used as components of the hash key.
+	// Entries are deduplicated by headerName (case-insensitive); only the first occurrence is kept.
+	// +optional
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinItems=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxItems=16
+	Headers []ConsistentHashHeader `json:"headers,omitempty"`
+
+	// Cookies specifies cookies whose values are used as components of the hash key.
+	// Entries are deduplicated by name; only the first occurrence is kept.
+	// +optional
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinItems=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxItems=16
+	Cookies []ConsistentHashCookie `json:"cookies,omitempty"`
+
+	// QueryParameters specifies URL query parameters whose values are used as components of the hash key.
+	// Entries are deduplicated by name; only the first occurrence is kept.
+	// +optional
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinItems=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxItems=16
+	QueryParameters []ConsistentHashQueryParameter `json:"queryParameters,omitempty"`
+
+	// FilterState specifies filter state objects whose values are used as components of the hash key.
+	// Entries are deduplicated by key; only the first occurrence is kept.
+	// +optional
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinItems=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxItems=16
+	FilterState []ConsistentHashFilterState `json:"filterState,omitempty"`
+
+	// SourceIP specifies that the request's source IP address is used as a component of the hash key.
+	// +optional
+	SourceIP *ConsistentHashSourceIP `json:"sourceIp,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashHeader uses a request header's value as a component of the hash key.
+type ConsistentHashHeader struct {
+	// HeaderName is the name of the request header.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=256
+	HeaderName string `json:"headerName"`
+
+	// RegexRewrite, if set, rewrites the header value using the regex before it is hashed.
+	// +optional
+	RegexRewrite *ConsistentHashRegexRewrite `json:"regexRewrite,omitempty"`
+
+	// Terminal, if true and a hash key is available after evaluating this hash policy,
+	// causes the subsequent hash policies to be skipped.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal *bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashRegexRewrite rewrites a value using a regular expression.
+type ConsistentHashRegexRewrite struct {
+	// Pattern is the regex pattern to match. It must be a valid RE2 regular expression.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=1024
+	Pattern string `json:"pattern"`
+
+	// Substitution is the replacement string for the matched pattern.
+	// It can include backreferences to capture groups from the pattern (e.g., \1, \2).
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=1024
+	Substitution string `json:"substitution"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashCookie uses a cookie's value as a component of the hash key.
+type ConsistentHashCookie struct {
+	// Name is the name of the cookie.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=256
+	Name string `json:"name"`
+
+	// TTL specifies the time to live of the cookie. If set, a cookie with this TTL
+	// is generated when the cookie is not present. A zero TTL generates a session cookie.
+	// Accepts a duration (e.g. "1h30m") or an integer number of seconds (e.g. "3600").
+	// +optional
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=32
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:XValidation:rule="self.matches('^([0-9]+|([0-9]+(\\\\.[0-9]+)?(h|m|s|ms|us|ns))+)$')",message="ttl must be a duration (e.g. 1h30m) or an integer number of seconds"
+	TTL *string `json:"ttl,omitempty"`
+
+	// Path is the path of the generated cookie.
+	// +optional
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=1024
+	Path *string `json:"path,omitempty"`
+
+	// Attributes are additional attributes (e.g. SameSite, Secure) added to the generated cookie.
+	// They are passed through to Envoy as-is.
+	// +optional
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxItems=16
+	Attributes []ConsistentHashCookieAttribute `json:"attributes,omitempty"`
+
+	// Terminal, if true and a hash key is available after evaluating this hash policy,
+	// causes the subsequent hash policies to be skipped.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal *bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashCookieAttribute is an attribute of a generated cookie.
+type ConsistentHashCookieAttribute struct {
+	// Name is the name of the attribute (e.g. SameSite, Secure).
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=256
+	Name string `json:"name"`
+
+	// Value is the value of the attribute.
+	// +optional
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=1024
+	Value string `json:"value,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashQueryParameter uses a URL query parameter's value as a component of the hash key.
+type ConsistentHashQueryParameter struct {
+	// Name is the name of the query parameter.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=256
+	Name string `json:"name"`
+
+	// Terminal, if true and a hash key is available after evaluating this hash policy,
+	// causes the subsequent hash policies to be skipped.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal *bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashFilterState uses a filter state object's value as a component of the hash key.
+type ConsistentHashFilterState struct {
+	// Key is the name of the filter state object.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=256
+	Key string `json:"key"`
+
+	// Terminal, if true and a hash key is available after evaluating this hash policy,
+	// causes the subsequent hash policies to be skipped.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal *bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashSourceIP uses the request's source IP address as a component of the hash key.
+type ConsistentHashSourceIP struct {
+	// Terminal, if true and a hash key is available after evaluating this hash policy,
+	// causes the subsequent hash policies to be skipped.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal *bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
